task_instance: Deploy an Azure OpenAI model (e.g. gpt-4o-mini) to the optimal available region using the skill's workflow: verify Azure auth, check current project's region capacity via 'az cognitiveservices account list-models'/'modelCapacities' REST calls, fall back to a multi-region capacity query if needed, then run 'az cognitiveservices account deployment create' with GlobalStandard SKU.
blocker_detail: The skill's entire deliverable is deploying a model into a real Microsoft Foundry / Azure OpenAI project. This requires: (1) the Azure CLI (not installed in this runtime, and installing it would need azuresearch-usnc.nuget.org / Microsoft package repos which the agent proxy blocked as 'connect_rejected' when checked), and more fundamentally (2) an active, authenticated Azure subscription with Cognitive Services read/create permissions and a real PROJECT_RESOURCE_ID pointing at an existing Microsoft Foundry project. There is no way to fabricate or substitute this - it is a paid, account-bound cloud service, and the task explicitly forbids using/searching for credentials or paid/account-bound services. Confirmed 'az' is absent ('az: command not found') and 'az account show' cannot run, so even step 1 (verify authentication) cannot be attempted.
evidence: Ran `which az; az --version; az account show` -> exit code 127, 'az: command not found' for all three, plus the agent proxy separately rejected outbound access to azuresearch-usnc.nuget.org:443 (a Microsoft package source), showing that even installing the Azure CLI tooling is not reliably possible here. The skill's core steps (Phase 1: 'Verify Auth' via az login/az account show; Phase 2+: operate on a real Microsoft Foundry project resource ID and deploy an OpenAI model) all require a live, credentialed Azure subscription with billing enabled - an account-bound paid cloud resource that cannot be created or accessed within this sandbox without credentials, which are explicitly off-limits.
